scripts.build:android: react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform android --dev true --bundle-output dist/main.android.jsbundle --assets-dest dist/res
scripts.build:ios: react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform ios --dev true --bundle-output dist/main.ios.jsbundle --assets-dest dist
scripts.e2e:android: react-native run-android --appId com.surrealdbharness.rn86 --no-packager && react-native-harness --harnessRunner android --testPathIgnorePatterns surrealkv-seed surrealkv-restart
scripts.e2e:ios: pnpm run prepare:ios && react-native run-ios --scheme SurrealDbHarness --simulator "${SURREALDB_IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17 Pro}" --no-packager && react-native-harness --harnessRunner ios --testPathIgnorePatterns surrealkv-seed surrealkv-restart
scripts.e2e:local-authority:android: react-native run-android --appId com.surrealdbharness.rn86 --no-packager && bash scripts/run-local-authority-e2e.sh android
scripts.e2e:local-authority:ios: pnpm run prepare:ios && react-native run-ios --scheme SurrealDbHarness --simulator "${SURREALDB_IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17 Pro}" --no-packager && bash scripts/run-local-authority-e2e.sh ios
scripts.e2e:sync-restart:android: react-native run-android --appId com.surrealdbharness.rn86 --no-packager && react-native-harness --harnessRunner android --testPathPatterns surrealkv-seed && react-native-harness --harnessRunner android --testPathPatterns surrealkv-restart
scripts.e2e:sync-restart:ios: pnpm run prepare:ios && react-native run-ios --scheme SurrealDbHarness --simulator "${SURREALDB_IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17 Pro}" --no-packager && react-native-harness --harnessRunner ios --testPathPatterns surrealkv-seed && react-native-harness --harnessRunner ios --testPathPatterns surrealkv-restart
scripts.ios: pnpm run prepare:ios && react-native run-ios --scheme SurrealDbHarness --simulator "${SURREALDB_IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17 Pro}"
